issues.title: Illegible thumbnail caption overlay
issues.description: Text inside the first media card lacks sufficient contrast against the dark gradient.
issues.evidence: 'Bedroom · king bed' text in the left thumbnail is nearly invisible against dark background.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast or adjust text color token for dark theme legibility.
issues.triageNote: Root cause is entirely in the read-only eval page pair-147 (src/app/eval/pair-147/page.tsx:217): the caption uses hardcoded neutral classes (text-neutral-200 over a from-neutral-600...to-neutral-950 gradient + bg-black/40) which invert in dark theme; the component contributes no styling to the caption, and eval pages may not be edited (blocked-external for the fix).

apiErgonomics.summary: Two audited API traps (documented on pair-082 and pair-095, both pairs ultimately passed using wrapper workarounds): (1) user className/style land on the INNER absolutely-positioned layer of Radix AspectRatio, so width utilities and margins do not size or space the ratio box; (2) the box is width:100% of its PARENT with padding-bottom ratio height, so a fixed width must be applied to a width-constrained parent. Verified live: docs demos rendered 160x1817 and 192x1022 slivers before the fix.
apiErgonomics.fix: Demos portrait/square now use the width-constrained-parent pattern; component source carries JSDoc API notes teaching the pattern. Verified 160x284 (9/16) and 192x192 (1/1) after the fix.
